title: Air Force Manned Orbiting Laboratory, cancelled 1969

tellings.quote: And then in June of 1969, exactly 1 month before the Apollo mission reached the moon for the first time, the man orbiting laboratory was cancelled.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the Manned Orbiting Laboratory, a 1960s US Air Force plan to put crews in a small station in orbit, which he says was kept secret until 2015. He points out that it was cancelled in June 1969, exactly one month before the Apollo mission, NASA's program to fly astronauts to the Moon, first landed there. He tells it because the timing hints that a hidden military space effort ran alongside the public one.
